case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready to put this job onto the shop floor. We want to talk about exactly that: steady work for your shop on the HX pump shaft, at a price that holds up against the competition.

Several suppliers are bidding for this part, and the award goes to the best package. We cannot promise it in advance. Option A is the package we can approve, because the claims below set the price level and the terms give your shop a clear order.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On competition:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On the cost side:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

Beyond the terms, we will act as a reference customer for your other clients, share our rolling forecast with you every quarter, approve your invoices within days of receipt, and name you a preferred supplier for this part family. None of this costs you anything.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, I looked at your numbers and the 14 days payment is good for us, so we can do that. I checked the material costs and the competition you mentioned, and I can drop the price to €30.50. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and rival quote and quality record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

So, we can offer a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that you need to clarify this internally and will come back to us on price. We would like to make that internal conversation as simple as possible.

Several suppliers are bidding for the HX pump shaft, and the award goes to the best package. We cannot promise it in advance. Option A is the package we can approve, and it keeps your CNC machines working on a part for a reference customer you already know.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.92; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

For whoever approves this on your side: Option A gives your shop a clear order at the payment term you have already called good for you, with a lead time you have already quoted. Nothing in it needs further negotiation on payment or delivery. It only needs a decision on the price.

Please take Option A to your approver and let us know the outcome. We would like to find a fair solution for both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. I am the owner, so I make the decisions here directly, no need for internal talks. 

I can drop the price to €28.00 per unit for the 14 days payment and 35 days lead time. So our offer is a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. 

You mention several suppliers are bidding, but I need to see some proof of these other offers. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work together with you and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to offer you a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 52 days. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We really look forward to hearing from you soon and hope we can start a great cooperation!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner. Option A is built for that: it gives you the planning security of a clear term sheet for the HX series shaft, and it is the package we can approve.

On quality:
Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the cost side:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

Several bidders are competing for this part, and the award goes to the best package, without any promise before then. Option A is our strongest offer because it combines the payment term and lead time that fit the evidence above.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Beyond the options, we will act as a reference customer for your other clients, share our rolling forecast with you every quarter, approve your invoices within days of receipt, and name you a preferred supplier for this part family.

For your management, in plain words: Option A gives Strojírna Hrvelec the most favourable payment term of our three options, a firm lead time and a clear basis for long-term planning with us. We ask you to take Option A to the person who decides on your side.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Hi, I looked at your options, but a 35-day lead time means rush production and would actually push the price up! I checked the alloy surcharge drop and the quality numbers, so I can offer you a discount to €31.00. This is based on 52 days lead time and 45 days payment, which is the best way to keep the price low. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current Angebot is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit. This alternative is at standard terms: a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Option B: unit price EUR 26.96; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

Options B and C are genuine alternatives if a shorter payment term suits you better.

Please take Option A to your management as it stands. It gives Strojírna Hrvelec a firm term sheet for the HX series shaft and a stable basis for planning with us.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

You wrote that faster payment is welcome and that you have free capacity for our parts. Option A answers both: quicker payment and a binding volume over a long contract, which keeps your shop busy with steady call-offs.

Your quality was 318 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70250@2026Q3).

We would like to find a fair solution that works for both of our family companies.

Best regards

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
